description: Administrator invariant: a write that would leave no active administrator is refused.

preconditions: No other administrative write is running.
cases.return: Returns "ok" after the administrator lock was taken and the write ran inside one Read Committed transaction that is then committed.

cases.inputs: write: removing AdminUsers from a role.
preconditions: Another guarded write (for example deactivating the last administrator) holds the lock.
cases.return: The call waits for the first write to commit, then runs against the committed state, so two legal-looking changes cannot combine into a system with no administrator.

cases.inputs: write: a function returning a failure result without saving.
preconditions: The write returns a refusal result (for example MSG12 or MSG17).
cases.return: The refusal is returned unchanged to the caller; nothing was written, so the commit leaves the database as it was.

cases.exception: The thrown exception propagates (translated when it is a persistence error).
cases.inputs: write: a function that throws after changing rows.
cases.return: The exception reaches the caller and the transaction is rolled back, so no partial change stays and the lock is released.

cases.inputs: write: a function returning a value.
preconditions: The caller already runs inside a guarded transaction (for example creating a role inside an administrator write).
cases.return: The write runs inside the existing transaction and is not committed early; the outer call commits it. Taking the lock again is harmless.
